details: The @or-sdk/lookup package runs a preinstall hook (node setup.mjs) that downloads the Bun runtime from github[.]com/oven-sh/bun and uses it to execute a 727KB obfuscated script (math_init.js) bundled in the package. math_init.js is obfuscated with a string-array decoder and array-shuffle (javascript-obfuscator signature) and contains eval/Function/child_process calls. This install-time payload is unrelated to the package's declared functionality (a Lookup/Weaviate SDK client). The package also declares a dependency on @or-sdk/base, a known-malicious package.

cwes.name: Inclusion of Functionality from Untrusted Control Sphere
